meta.title: wp-portfolio
meta.description: Gonzalo Alcina's portfolio theme with its living design system.
meta.author: Gonzaloalcina

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// Pretty permalinks, as on the live site.
update_option( 'permalink_structure', '/%postname%/' );

// Rank Math prints its tags only after registration is skipped or connected.
update_option( 'rank_math_registration_skip', 1 );

// The living design system page: noindex in Rank Math, demo card icon.
$page_id = wp_insert_post(
	array(
		'post_type'   => 'page',
		'post_title'  => 'Design system',
		'post_name'   => 'design-system',
		'post_status' => 'publish',
	)
);
update_post_meta( $page_id, 'rank_math_robots', array( 'noindex' ) );
update_post_meta( $page_id, 'demo_card_icon', 'gauge' );

flush_rewrite_rules();
